pattern: a compliance rule travels slowly between teams (7 h 19 min from the incident team to Vicky's desks, through a watch line nobody acted on) and fast within one (eleven confirmations in 24 minutes). Where the agents may not read, a person reads (Vicky, 13:10). The agents disclose their own earlier reads.
